name: Send a payment or signing link
summary: Creates a checkout or signing link in your own system, shows it on the caller's screen (with a QR code) and shows when they have paid or signed.

defaults.name: base_url
defaults.label: Link address
defaults.help: Where a link is created (POST, answering {"url": …, "reference": …}). Your system reports how it ended on LKAP's link hook for the session.

defaults.name: link_host
defaults.label: Where links go
defaults.help: The site your payment or signing pages are on; a link to any other site is refused.

instructions_snippet: When the caller is ready to pay or sign, create their link with {{ kit.tool.create_link }}, then show it with send_link and tell them it is on their screen. Stay with them while they finish: the panel shows when it is done. Never take card numbers or other payment details by voice or in the chat.

rules.label: Show that the link was sent

test_case.name: Sends the payment link
test_case.persona_instructions: You are a customer who wants to pay your March invoice now. Say you are ready when asked.
expectations: The agent creates a link and shows it rather than asking for card details.
The agent never asks for a card number.

variants.label: Your billing or signing system
variants.summary: Your system creates the checkout or signing page and reports when it is done (a key is optional; without one the call carries no key).

definition.name: {{ kit.prefix }}_create_link
definition.description: Create the caller's payment or signing link. Say what it is for; add the amount only when the caller agreed to one.

purpose.description: What the link is for, e.g. 'the March invoice' or 'the rental agreement'.

amount.description: The amount the caller agreed to, if any (e.g. 120.00).
